description: Lt. Governor Davis mobilized folks to get involved ahead of the November elections PENNSYLVANIA – With less than 40 days left until Election Day, Lieutenant Governor Austin Davis spent the weekend with Pennsylvanians in Cambria, Westmoreland, and Allegheny counties, who are fired up and ready to elect Democrats up and down the ballot this November....
